verdicts.reason: A keeps the bottle and its cream disc intact, but the disc is cropped into the top-left corner. The subhead is indented away from the headline's left edge, NEW and Try It sit right-aligned on an unrelated axis, and the bottom third is empty dead space. B separates the cream backing disc from the bottle and leaves it as a stray dot in the bottom-left corner, so the bottle disappears orange-on-orange apart from its label and dots. B also makes the NEW badge nearly as large as the CTA, so the two compete, and pushes Try It almost onto the bottom edge.
